description: This Java source file defines an Android ListActivity class named List6, which displays a list of Shakespeare speeches with expandable dialogue sections using a custom ListAdapter and View components.

classes.name: List6
classes.description: Main activity class extending ListActivity; manages the list view and handles item click events.

classes.name: SpeechListAdapter
classes.description: Inner class extending BaseAdapter; manages the list data, view creation, and toggle expansion state for each list item.

classes.name: SpeechView
classes.description: Inner class extending LinearLayout; custom view representing each list item with title and expandable dialogue.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the activity's onCreate method to initialize the list with a custom adapter.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles click events on list items, toggling the expanded state of the clicked item.

methods.name: SpeechListAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializes the adapter with context; manages list data including titles, dialogues, and expansion states.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of speech items in the list.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the position index as the data item.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Uses position as the unique ID for list items.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses SpeechView for each list item, updating its content based on position and expansion state.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the expanded/collapsed state of a list item and refreshes the view.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title text in SpeechView.

methods.name: setDialogue
methods.description: Sets the dialogue text in SpeechView.

methods.name: setExpanded
methods.description: Expands or collapses the dialogue view in SpeechView.
